description: This file contains unit tests for the BasketWithItemsSpecification, a specification class used to filter Basket entities based on their ID or BuyerId. It uses Xunit for testing and NSubstitute for mocking Basket objects.

classes.name: BasketWithItems
classes.description: A test class containing multiple unit tests for the BasketWithItemsSpecification class.

methods.name: MatchesBasketWithGivenBasketId
methods.description: Tests that the specification correctly matches a basket with a given ID.

methods.name: MatchesNoBasketsIfBasketIdNotPresent
methods.description: Tests that the specification does not match any baskets if the ID is not present.

methods.name: MatchesBasketWithGivenBuyerId
methods.description: Tests that the specification correctly matches a basket with a specific BuyerId.

methods.name: MatchesNoBasketsIfBuyerIdNotPresent
methods.description: Tests that no baskets are matched if the BuyerId is not present in the collection.

methods.name: GetTestBasketCollection
methods.description: Creates and returns a list of mock Basket objects with predefined IDs and BuyerId.
